notes: Google released lyria-3.5 in public preview on 2026-09-03.
Supported inputs are text and image; outputs are audio and text/lyrics.
Lyria 3.5 generates full-length structurally coherent songs as 44.1 kHz stereo audio.
The model is accessed through the Interactions API.
Image-conditioned generation supports up to 10 images alongside text.
Default audio output is MP3; WAV can be requested using response_format.
Audio generation is supported, while caching, code execution, file search, function calling, Live API, search grounding, structured outputs, thinking, and URL context are explicitly unsupported.
Batch API, Flex inference, and Priority inference are explicitly unsupported.
Computer-use and MCP support are not declared in the checked model documentation and therefore remain unknown.
